auditor_zoe: Hi, quick ask from the ISO auditor: they want an auditable trail that ties a recent RBAC change on a service account to KMS decrypt activity and the approval chain. Deliverables: PR link + approvers, Jira ticket, cloud audit row, KMS decrypt lines for same principal/timeframe, triage note if this was remediation, and a signed manifest with sha256. Can you assemble?

leo_seceng: Acknowledged. We'll build a minimal bundle: `pr-approval.png`, `iam-audit.json` (redacted), `kms-decrypts.log` (sanitized), `jira-ENG-8144.pdf`, `triage.md`, `manifest.txt`, `manifest.sha256`.

maya_cloud: I ran the audit query and exported the single matching row. Query (GCP): `protoPayload.methodName:\"SetIamPolicy\" AND resource.type:\"service_account\" AND protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail:rotator@*` window 2027-01-11T09:10:00Z..2027-01-11T09:20:00Z. Snippet (redacted):
```
{"timestamp":"2027-01-11T09:12:03Z","actor":"leo_seceng@redwood-inference.com","target":"serviceAccounts/rotator@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com","bindings_before":["roles/pubsub.publisher"],"bindings_after":["roles/pubsub.publisher","roles/secretmanager.secretAccessor"]}
```

evans_ops: PR is github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4624 approved by `@leo_seceng` and `@evan_ops`. Comment: "approved scoped secret access for rotation job". No rollback. Screenshots attached in bundle.

auditor_zoe: Please ensure the KMS decrypts show the *same principal* and include a deterministic principal hash so the auditor can match without exposing emails publicly.

maya_cloud: KMS decrypt lines (sanitized):
```
2027-01-11T09:12:04Z projects/redwood/locations/us/keyRings/ops/cryptoKeys/rot-v4 principal=rotator@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com action=decrypt
2027-01-11T09:12:05Z projects/redwood/locations/us/keyRings/ops/cryptoKeys/rot-v4 principal=rotator@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com action=decrypt
```

ash_devsec: Triage note: this was a remediation for RD-2027-03 (rotation job lacked secret access). I wrote `triage.md` describing root cause, remediation steps, reviewers, and verification commands (`gcloud iam service-accounts get-iam-policy` + `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy`).

evans_ops: For chain-of-custody, packaging metadata will include `packaged_by=evan_ops`, `packaged_at=2027-01-12T08:30:00Z`. We use `tools/compliance/package_evidence.sh --ticket=ENG-8144 --start=2027-01-11T09:00Z --end=2027-01-11T10:00Z`.

packagerbot: EvidenceBuilder: job started by evan_ops at 2027-01-12T08:30:02Z job_id=evid-20270112-0830. Output zip uploaded to s3://redwood-compliance/evidence/ENG-8144/pkg-20270112-0830.zip size=2.1MB checksum=4b7c9d2f... retention=365d object_lock=GOVERNANCE.

auditor_zoe: Good. Add `principal_hashes.csv` with lines like `rotator,sha256(rotator@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com)=e99a18c...` and note where unhashed mapping is stored (compliance vault) for NDA release. Also certify that export buckets have Object Lock and restricted ACLs.

leo_seceng: Done. Manifest includes `principal_hashes.csv` reference and `unhashed_principal_location=compliance-vault://ENG-8144/principal_map`. I confirmed buckets: `s3://redwood-compliance` has Object Lock GOV, retention 365d, writes limited to `compliance-service` and `ops-bot`.

auditor_zoe: Please post the final S3 link + `manifest.sha256` here when ready and mark ENG-8144 resolved. Thanks. :thumbsup:

evans_ops: Uploaded and posted above. Marking ENG-8144 resolved in Jira.

packagerbot: EvidenceBuilder: upload verified, job_id=evid-20270112-0830 status=success.

auditor_zoe: Received bundle. I'll validate and follow up if they need the unhashed mapping under NDA. Thanks everyone.
